resources.string: HeyBroc uses the AccessibilityService API only inside 12 supported grocery retailers (15 Android app packages: Walmart, Instacart, Target, Kroger, ALDI, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Amazon Shopping / Amazon Fresh & Whole Foods Market, Sam\'s Club, BJ\'s, Costco, and Shipt) to inspect visible, non-editable screen text on device, send matched visible product titles, visible ingredient lists, visible barcode text (if displayed on screen), and up to 20 visible cart item titles over HTTPS to heybroc.com to compute your 0–100 ingredient score and cart summary, and enter Clean Swap items into the store\'s search bar only when you tap Find or Swap in Store. Invisible nodes, password, payment, editable, and chat inputs are ignored and personal data is never sold.
